title: configure-module input
description: Configuration parameters for NethServer 8 Business Roadwarrior VPN (ns8-vpn)

endpoint_host.description: Public FQDN, DDNS hostname, or static public IP address reachable by VPN clients

wg_port.description: Public UDP port for WireGuard roadwarrior connections (must not be 55820)

tunnel_mode.description: Routing mode: split (internal networks only) or full (0.0.0.0/0)

allowed_cidrs.description: Internal destination IPv4 CIDRs permitted in split-tunnel mode

dns_servers.description: DNS server IPv4 addresses pushed to VPN clients

dns_search_domain.description: Optional internal DNS search domain (e.g. ad.company.lan)

wg_mtu.description: WireGuard tunnel MTU (default 1380 for PPPoE/FritzBox compatibility)

nat_enabled.description: Enable SNAT masquerading from VPN transfer subnet towards LAN/WAN

user_domain.description: Bound NS8 user domain name (Samba AD or OpenLDAP via ldapproxy)

vpn_group.description: AD/LDAP group name authorized for VPN dial-in

max_devices_per_user.description: Maximum number of concurrent registered devices per user

sync_interval_minutes.description: Background AD/LDAP synchronization interval in minutes

portal_enabled.description: Expose the Self-Service Portal behind ns8-traefik

portal_domain.description: Virtual host FQDN for the Self-Service Portal

portal_lets_encrypt.description: Request automatic Let's Encrypt certificate on Traefik

portal_http2https.description: Redirect HTTP to HTTPS on Traefik

ovpn_enabled.description: Enable OpenVPN TCP/UDP hotel/guest-network fallback server

ovpn_port.description: Local OpenVPN listen port on the NS8 node (e.g. 1194)

ovpn_public_port.description: External WAN/router port written into .ovpn client profiles (e.g. 443 or 1194)

ovpn_totp_required.description: Require trailing 6-digit TOTP code appended to AD/LDAP password on OpenVPN connect
